mapper.select: SELECT id, corp_id, agent_id, agent_secret_enc, callback_token, encoding_aes_key, connected, last_error, welcome_enabled, welcome_text, default_lead_user_id, default_lead_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_wecom_config ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, corp_id, agent_id, agent_secret_enc, callback_token, encoding_aes_key, connected, last_error, welcome_enabled, welcome_text, default_lead_user_id, default_lead_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM crm_wecom_config WHERE corp_id = #{corpId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_config ( corp_id, agent_id, agent_secret_enc, callback_token, encoding_aes_key, connected, last_error, welcome_enabled, welcome_text, default_lead_user_id, default_lead_dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{agentId}, #{agentSecretEnc}, #{callbackToken}, #{encodingAesKey}, CASE WHEN #{connected,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{lastError}, #{welcomeEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{welcomeText}, #{defaultLeadUserId}, #{defaultLeadDeptId}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE crm_wecom_config
corp_id = #{corpId}, agent_id = #{agentId}, agent_secret_enc = #{agentSecretEnc}, callback_token = #{callbackToken}, encoding_aes_key = #{encodingAesKey}, connected = CASE WHEN #{connected,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, last_error = #{lastError}, welcome_enabled = #{welcomeEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, welcome_text = #{welcomeText},
default_lead_user_id = #{defaultLeadUserId}, default_lead_dept_id = #{defaultLeadDeptId},
update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime},
WHERE id = #{id}
